title: Download the PlanQ app
subtitle: Never miss a work notification. Get real-time alerts with the mobile app.

desktop.hint: Open this address on your phone to install

inApp.title: You're already in the PlanQ app

notifyNote: The app supports real-time push notifications on iOS and Android.

androidPwa.stepChrome: In Chrome, open the menu (⋮) at the top right and tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
androidPwa.stepSamsung: In Samsung Internet, open the menu (≡) at the bottom and tap "Add page to" → "Home screen".
androidPwa.stepConfirm: Tap "Install" and a PlanQ icon appears on your home screen.
androidPwa.installed: PlanQ is already installed on this device. Open it from the PlanQ icon on your home screen.
androidPwa.done: Installed. Launch PlanQ from your home screen.
androidPwa.dismissed: Installation was cancelled. You can tap it again anytime.
androidPwa.onPhone: Open planq.kr/app on your Android phone to install it.
androidPwa.storeSoon: Our Play Store app is in review — once it is live you can get it right here.
